deployability_predicate.statement: A coverage entry is deployable if and only if every artifact in required_artifacts resolves for it, AND no severity-high gap in gap_register.md is open against it, AND — where its decision path has consumer_decision true — that path satisfies every obligation in decision_paths.json.
deployability_predicate.why: There is deliberately no `deployable: true` field. A self-asserted flag is exactly how an unvalidated model reaches production; this predicate cannot be satisfied by assertion.

evidence_admission.applies_to: any value derived by a language or text model

requires.source_spans: resolvable spans in a governed corpus

evidence_admission.why: 0072 REQ-016. Extraction is useful and unverified. Labelling it evidence keeps it usable without letting it silently become the basis of a credit decision.

required_artifacts.name: Credit model card
credit_specific_fields: default_definition_id the model is calibrated to
performance window and its alignment to the decision date
segment performance, including segments relevant to fairness testing
downturn treatment where the parameter feeds regulatory capital
known limitations and conditions of use
required_artifacts.why: A model card without the default definition and performance window cannot be checked for the two errors that matter most: basis mismatch and outcome-window leakage.

required_artifacts.name: Independent validation evidence
requires: validator identity distinct from the developer
required_artifacts.why: Independence is the point. A developer's own testing, however thorough, is not validation.

required_artifacts.name: Challenger or benchmark comparison
requires: decision rationale where the champion is retained
required_artifacts.why: A model with no benchmark cannot be shown to be better than the simpler thing it replaced.

required_artifacts.name: Monitoring plan with thresholds
required_artifacts.why: 0072 NFR and P6: a model is not done until you can tell whether it is working.

required_artifacts.name: Override and exception log
required_artifacts.why: Overrides are where a model's real behaviour diverges from its documented behaviour. An unlogged override is an undetectable one.

required_artifacts.name: Named owner
requires: a person or role accountable for the model in production
required_artifacts.why: P6. An unowned model in production has no one to notice it failing.

required_artifacts.name: Kill switch or fallback policy
requires: documented fallback (prior version, alternative model, or human decision)
required_artifacts.why: P5. Reversibility is a precondition of deployment, not a launch-day task.
